mapper.select: SELECT GROUPCD ,GROUPNAME ,COMCD ,COMNAME ,USERID ,USERNAME ,GRADE ,GUBUN ,CHK FROM USER_ID A WHERE 1=1 AND CHK != 'N' AND A.USERID = #{SID} AND A.USERPASS = #{SPASS}

SELECT POS.GROUPCD, POS.GROUPNAME, POS.COMCD, POS.COMNAME, POS.POSNO, POS.POSNAME, POS.CHK, COM.TAXNAME, COM.SANO, COM.CARDSHOPNO, COM.OWNER, COM.TELNO, COM.COADDR, COM.MEMPER, COM.CARDPER, COM.GOLDPER, COM.SILVERPER, COM.GREENPER, COM.BIRTH_POINT, COM.MEMREG_POINT FROM POS_ID POS,COMPANY_TB COM WHERE 1=1 AND POS.COMCD = COM.COMCD AND POS.CHK != 'N' AND AND POS.POSNO = = #{POSNO}

SELECT P.GUBUN,P.PROGRAM,P.PROGNAME,P.PROGKIND,P.PARM,P.COMPANY FROM PROG_INFO P, USER_PROG U WHERE P.PROGID = U.PROGID AND U.USERID = 'polsse' AND P.GUBUN != '' AND P.PROGKIND = #{PROGKIND} ORDER BY P.NEWID
SELECT top 20 NEWS_KEY ,GROUPCD ,GROUPNAME ,NEWS_DATE ,NEWS_TIME ,TITLE ,CONTENT ,END_DATE ,FILENAME FROM GROUP_NEWS ORDER BY GROUPCD ,NEWS_DATE ,NEWS_TIME

SELECT CDATE ,get_date_fmt(CDATE) CDATE_FMT ,SUM(AMT) AMT ,SUM(CASHAMT) CASHAMT ,SUM(CARDAMT) CARDAMT ,SUM(VISITCNT) VISITCNT ,(IF VISITCNT = 0 THEN 0 ELSE CONVERT(DECIMAL(12,0),AMT / VISITCNT) ENDIF) AVGAMT FROM SHOP_MST WHERE CDATE > DATEFORMAT(GETDATE() -40 ,'YYYYMM00') GROUP BY CDATE ORDER BY CDATE
